name: Americana Restaurants International PLC
summary: Americana Restaurants International PLC operates a chain of restaurant in the United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Egypt, Qatar, Kazakhstan, Bahrain, Jordan, Oman, Lebanon, Morocco, and Iraq. It operates quick service, fast casual, indulgence, casual dining, and coffee restaurants across the dine-in, take-away, drive-thru, car-hop, and home delivery channels. The company was founded in 1964 and is headquartered in Sharjah, the United Arab Emirates. Americana Restaurants International PLC is a subsidiary of Adeptio AD Investments Ltd.
